name: West Virginia
sources: W. Va. Code 11-21-4j (code.wvlegislature.gov/pdf/11-21-4j/): rates for taxable years beginning on or after Jan 1, 2026 (single, head of household and joint share one schedule; married filing separately uses half the thresholds)

West Virginia IT-140 2025 instructions (tax.wv.gov/Documents/PIT/2025/it140.PersonalIncomeTaxFormsAndInstructions.2025.pdf): starts from federal AGI; $2,000 per exemption; no standard or itemized deduction
West Virginia Schedule M 2025, line 47 (tax.wv.gov/Documents/PIT/2025/it140.Schedule-M.2025.pdf): senior citizen modification up to $8,000 per person 65+
provisional: The $2,000 exemption and $8,000 senior modification are statutory amounts from the 2025 forms; the 2026 forms are not yet published.
notes: The senior deduction of up to $8,000 per person 65+ is limited to that person's own income and reduced by pension and Social Security subtractions; it is applied in full here.
The low-income earned income exclusion and family tax credit are not included.
